items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 April 2026 11:12am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 26 April 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the east at first, becoming variable for a time this evening before settling north or northwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then an increased risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches soon developing.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in places, veering east or northeast 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, still with a risk of mist and fog patches in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.
